newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold firms, volume up on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold firms, volume up on arbitrage.

text.p: Istanbul gold exchange volume surged to 1,301 kilos on Thursday from Wednesday's 180 kilos as banks made arbitrage deals, dealers said.
Gold closed firmer at $346.00 an ounce and 1,562,400 lira per gram, up from $343.80 and 1,555,900 lira on Wednesday, following higher levels on European markets.
"With the firmer prices, there was little demand from the free market. Most of the day's trade was from banks engaging in arbitrage," one dealer said.
The Turkish lira eased to 140,300 against the dollar from the previous 139,980 close, supporting the rise in lira prices.
Most of the day's trade -- 901 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 60.3 percent of total trade conducted in dollar terms.
